## Properties

### ExitProcessOnFinish

```csharp
public bool ExitProcessOnFinish { get; set; }
```

Whether the process ends when the activity finishes, once the game has stopped. Off by default, as an app may have more to it than the game, and the next launch in the same process starts the game afresh. A game whose own static state doesn't survive that can turn it on.
